title: Democrats hit out at Nvidia and Trump over Huang’s return – US politics live
summary: Possible presidential hopeful Ruben Gallego warns of a ‘bad lesson for corporate America’ while Ro Khanna says ‘rules should apply to everyone’

blocks.text:
Possible presidential hopeful Ruben Gallego warns of a ‘bad lesson for corporate America’ while Ro Khanna says ‘rules should apply to everyone’

  • Congress to grill Huang over ties with China and Trump’s intervention

  • Sign up for the Breaking News US email

As we noted earlier, Nvidia’s freshly reinstated CEO Jensen Huang will appear on Capitol Hill next week, where skeptical lawmakers from both parties will grill him over his ties to a woman that some in the intelligence community have said was a spy for China. Huang will also sit for transcribed interviews with the Senate banking committee and House foreign affairs committee, as well as the select committee on the Chinese Communist party and the House intelligence committee. (Here’s my colleague Shrai Popat’s report).

Massachusetts Democrat Elizabeth Warren, the incoming Senate banking chair, has told Politico Playbook, “President Trump insisting that the company should rehire him does not get Mr. Huang or Nvidia off the hook.”

Yes, and not to Nvidia’s benefit.

Furthermore, we are prepared to respond decisively to any hostile moves by the enemy and, should the enemy commit a miscalculation, to shift the geography of the conflict.
